description: This file contains utility functions for loading and managing test projects, test files, suites, and related configurations in the Playwright test runner. It handles project collection, test file loading, suite creation, filtering, sharding, and error reporting.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used to organize and run tests.

methods.name: collectProjectsAndTestFiles
methods.description: Collects project files and sets up project suites based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: loadFileSuites
methods.description: Loads test suites from test files, manages dependencies, and populates project suites.

methods.name: createRootSuite
methods.description: Creates the root test suite, applies filtering, sharding, and handles 'only' tests.

methods.name: loadGlobalHook
methods.description: Loads a global setup hook from a specified file.

methods.name: loadReporter
methods.description: Loads a reporter implementation from a specified file.

methods.name: loadTestList
methods.description: Loads a list of tests from a file for filtering purposes.
